say:0:1010120001:0.text: Magister! There are two Chippys over there! Are they ghosts?
say:0:1010120001:0.source_cn: 主、主人！对面怎么有两个满满？是幽灵吗！
say:0:1010120001:0.male: Magister! There are two Chippys over there! Are they ghosts?
say:0:1010120001:0.female: Magister! There are two Chippys over there! Are they ghosts?

say:1:1010120002:0.text: Watch yourselves! I heard these Hypofiends can shapeshift!
say:1:1010120002:0.source_cn: 是高阶魔物！我听说过这东西，它们能幻化成不同样貌。
say:1:1010120002:0.male: Watch yourselves! I heard these Hypofiends can shapeshift!
say:1:1010120002:0.female: Watch yourselves! I heard these Hypofiends can shapeshift!

say:2:1010120003:0.text: Be vigilant. Don't be fooled by how they look!
say:2:1010120003:0.source_cn: 大家提高警惕，别被对方的模样欺骗了！
say:2:1010120003:0.male: Be vigilant. Don't be fooled by how they look!
say:2:1010120003:0.female: Be vigilant. Don't be fooled by how they look!
